name: Bromelain
short: Reported adverse events with oral use were flatulence, nausea and headache. A warfarin review lists it among products that may raise bleeding risk, based mostly on lab, animal or single-case data.
text: In a systematic review that included 54 articles, adverse events with oral bromelain included flatulence, nausea and headache, and major health risks were not reported. A review of warfarin interactions listed bromelain among herbal products that may potentially increase the risk of bleeding or potentiate the effects of warfarin, while noting that nearly all such information is based on in vitro data, animal studies or individual case reports.
